Consider the following statements about T - shaped cantilever retaining wall:

2. The heel slab is subjected to weight of soil that causes tension on top side and compression on bottom side of heel slab.
3. The toe slab is subjected to net downward soil pressure causing tension on bottom side and compression on top side.

The toe slab is subjected to net upward soil pressure that causes tension on bottom side and compression on top side.

questions.qtext:
Consider the following statements in reference to RCC over - reinforced beam section:
1. At the ultimate limit state, ultimate compressive strain in concrete is not attained at all.
2. At ultimate limit state, tensile strain in reinforcement bars is more than the yield strain.
3. Failure occurs after having ample signs of warning in beam
4. Code permits use of over - reinforced beam sections.
Which of the above statements are correct ?

options.text: None of the statements are correct

questions.solution:
(d)
• At the ultimate limit state, ultimate compressive strain in concrete is attained at all.
• At ultimate limit state, tensile strain in reinforcement bars may or may not be more than the yield strain.
• Failure occurs without any sign of warning in beam.
• Code does not allow use of over - reinforced beam sections.
